implementation_summary: Static WordPress-style local business fixture (fixtures/audit-site, 22 pages plus 404) covering every listed scenario, and startAuditSite(): 127.0.0.1 on an OS-chosen port, per-request log with method, path, status, user agent and startedAt/finishedAt, clearRequests(), 404 and 405 handling, traversal guard, no-store caching, {{ORIGIN}} replaced with the request Host, and an AUDIT_SITE_PAGES scenario map. 21 tests prove the helper and every scenario, including Chromium checks of JavaScript-inserted content and Tamil UTF-8, with off-origin requests aborted.
